artifacts.name: 0xDOGE Token
artifacts.oneLiner: First 0xBitcoin clone. Bricked after 12 mints. Fixed supply forever.
story: Deployed on February 16, 2018, just 10 days after 0xBitcoin, 0xDOGE was the first 0xBitcoin clone: a proof-of-work token mined by submitting solutions onchain.
A bug in the reward formula and a recursive era cap bricked the contract after 12 successful mints. No further mint can ever succeed.
1.2 million tokens exist, and no more can ever be created. 0xDOGE is the first proof-of-work token on Ethereum to permanently brick itself.
